text_block_list.text: One day, upon arriving at the gymnasium—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Phew... All right, that's all for today.
I should go wash off this sweat...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Flower-san, thank you for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Bourbon-san?
Are you starting your training... now?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Affirmative.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But I thought you mentioned
you were running outside today...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That operation was aborted due to rainfall.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, relocation to indoors has been executed.
Reconstructing routine from the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Reconstructing from the beginning...?
...You're starting all over from scratch?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. In order to carry out the projected training,
reconstruction is necessary.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I see...
Um, please don't overdo it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I shall compensate by performing
thorough post-training maintenance.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't that just mean you are overdoing it...?
......

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Alright!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon-san!
Thank goodness, you're still here...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Flower-san?
Do you need something from—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...*Sniff, sniff*. An aroma of food
is emanating from Flower-san.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I prepared some refreshments
for you in the waiting room next door, Bourbon-san.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: For me... is it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! You always work so hard, Bourbon-san, so
I wondered if there was anything I could do for you...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Cooking is a little hobby of mine.
The cafeteria staff let me borrow their kitchen!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...
Would you like to take a break soon?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Negative. I have not yet fulfilled my duty
to complete the designated operation...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But that's okay!
I made food that tastes delicious even when it's cold—
(*Grummmbbllle...*)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That sound just now...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Au... T-That was me.
Making it made me hungry...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Temporarily suspending operation.
I shall partake, with Flower-san joining me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Auuu~...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, well...
Please, help yourself!
